blocks.text: DENVER — Devin Booker led seven Phoenix players in doubles figures with 20 points and the Suns beat the Denver Nuggets 117-105 on Monday night for their first road win of the season. The Suns were playing on the second night of a back-to-back and looked hungrier with a 22-11 advantage in second-chance points. Phoenix, the worst rebounding team in the league, also had a 60-42 edge on the boards in improving to 1-3 away from home.
